    Class
    Description
    DataTablesRequest
    The DataTables server-side-processing request envelope — the JSON input bean paired with the DataTablesResults JSON output bean.
    DataTablesRequest.Column
    A DataTables column descriptor (columns[i]).
    DataTablesRequest.Fixed
    A DataTables 2.x fixed search term (search.fixed[i]): a named search applied through the DataTables API (search.fixed(name, term)) rather than typed by the user.
    DataTablesRequest.Order
    A DataTables ordering descriptor (order[i]): the index of the ordered column plus its direction.
    DataTablesRequest.Search
    A DataTables search descriptor ({value, regex, fixed}), used for both the global search and a column search.
    DataTablesResults
    The DataTables server-side-processing response envelope.
